messages:
deploy-bot: Deployed release 2026.03.22-09a to prod (canary->100%). Running post-deploy smoke: synth-chat, kv-prefill, http-probe.
Jade: synth-chat p95 in ap-south-1 jumped from 210ms -> 900ms ~40s after deploy. p50 steady. No 5xx in the probe.
Jade: probe dump:
```
probe=synth-chat region=ap-south-1
requests=500
p50=130ms
p95=900ms
p99=1700ms
errors=0
note: payload seq_len median increased due to new story-template change
```
Omar: this release enabled kernel scheduling heuristic H2 and a batching threshold bump. Could be interaction with longer sequences causing KV cache churn.
Jade: can we soft-pin ap-south-1 to previous runtime variant until we confirm? Prefer routing override rather than full rollback.
Omar: agree. @deploy-bot please apply routing-override region=ap-south-1 target=runtime-stable-20260321 reason="postdeploy-smoke-degradation"
deploy-bot: applying routing-override...
deploy-bot: routing-override applied for ap-south-1 -> runtime-stable-20260321 (ts=1822223360). Affected nodes: gpu-ap-1,gpu-ap-2.
oncall-bot: quick-check after override: synth-chat p95 back to 220ms within 25s, p99 480ms. No increase in errors.
infra-bot: opened INF-5402 to capture traces and KV metrics for H2 heuristic; tagging perf and runtime teams. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-5402
Jade: adding request-level trace for seq>150 in the staging repro. Omar can you run microbench comparing H1 vs H2 with seq set {64,128,256}?
Omar: will do. Also recommend adding a canary gate: if p95 > 2x baseline within 2m after rollout, auto-apply routing-override. Filing FR-115 to add to deploy-bot rules.
Jade: marking release as "region-pinned: ap-south-1" and notifying product & support. Will keep thread open until INF-5402 validated and H2 tuned.
deploy-bot: summary: routing-override applied for ap-south-1 -> runtime-stable-20260321; synth-chat recovered. Follow-ups: INF-5402, perf bench, deploy-bot canary-gate FR-115. Closing for now unless new regressions observed.
